summary: Fix NullPointerExceptions in services, remove commented-out repository code, and replace System.out with SLF4J logging.
rationale: Addressed java:S2259 by replacing .orElse(null) with .orElseThrow(), ensuring objects are not null before access. Fixed java:S106 by implementing @Slf4j and logging relevant info. Cleaned up java:S125 by removing dead code in the repository interface.

policy_compliance.evidence: Logic now explicitly handles missing entities by throwing exceptions instead of crashing with NPE, making it testable and robust.
Logs only contain operation names and non-sensitive identifiers (IDs/ShortNames).
Used orElseThrow() with IllegalArgumentException to provide explicit error messages instead of silent failures or NPEs.
